subject.title: Feishu channel dispatch completes with replies=0 even though assistant final text is written to session transcript

question: Should Feishu recover and deliver the latest transcript assistant final when dispatch has `replies=0`, or should the fix be limited to the earlier reply-result/source-delivery boundary that made the final disappear?
rationale: The report proves a useful local workaround, but deciding whether a channel may scrape transcript finals after dispatch affects privacy, duplicate sends, intentional silence, and `message_tool_only` behavior; automation should not choose that permanent fallback policy.

options.title: Require Live Metadata First
options.body: Run or request a redacted current-main Feishu group repro that shows replyResult, source-delivery mode, visible-send attempts, failed counts, and session transcript state before choosing the fix layer.

options.title: Approve Guarded Transcript Recovery
options.body: Allow Feishu to recover the current-turn transcript final only under a narrow, tested policy that prevents stale, duplicate, private, or intentionally silent delivery.

options.title: Keep Recovery Out Of Feishu
options.body: Treat transcript scraping as out of bounds and require the repair to happen in final payload assembly, shared dispatch accounting, or source-reply policy instead.

recommendation.title: Require Live Metadata First
recommendation.body: Run or request a redacted current-main Feishu group repro that shows replyResult, source-delivery mode, visible-send attempts, failed counts, and session transcript state before choosing the fix layer.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for Feishu fallback policy and shared delivery semantics is the follow-up/merge work on PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/87896.
